question: What teaching act is being announced such that the speaker will speak the method of names for them and calls on the addressee to hear?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names for them.
The addressee is called to hear.
The address is to one with beautiful eyes.
inference: The speaker announces an impending teaching of the method of names for those figures and urges the addressee to attend to it.
uncertainties: The referent of 'them' is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear, O beautiful-eyed one.
